children.game_version: A 'follow the drum' game where children move and stop based on the music.

seniors.counts: Simplified counts based on the drum beat.
seniors.seated_version: Perform the bell-shaking and seeking gestures while seated.
seniors.standing_version: Perform the dance in place without the full advance to the center.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Reduced tempo and limited range of motion.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Gestures of seeking or following an enemy during drum rolls.
movement_profile.footwork: Advancing steps toward the center; must stop with both feet on the ground on the final beat.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Dancers move from the perimeter toward the center of the arena.
movement_profile.posture: Upright, with head movements to keep roach crest feathers spinning.

signature_moves.description: Advancing toward the center of the arena during the Omaha beat phase.
signature_moves.name: The Sneak-Up

movement_profile.tempo_feel: Responsive to the changing beat of the drum.
movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Failing to stop on the last beat of the song; failing to keep the roach crest feathers moving.

music_profile.musical_form: Four renditions, with the fourth differing by continuing with straight Omaha renditions.
music_profile.rhythm_pattern: Drum rolls in the first half of renditions, followed by a standard Omaha beat in the second half.
music_profile.sound_description: The music is defined by the contrast between rapid drum rolls and the steady, driving pulse of the Omaha beat.

basic_steps: Shake bells and perform seeking gestures during drum rolls.
Advance toward the center of the arena during Omaha beats.
Stop movement completely on the last beat of the song with both feet on the ground.
Walk back to the perimeter of the arena.
teaching.formation: Dancers move from the perimeter toward the center of the arena.
teaching.level_notes: The dance is divided into categories for men, teens, juniors, and little boys.
teaching.rhythm: Alternating between drum rolls and the standard Omaha beat.
